# camera-composition

Purpose: Provide detailed composition and camera planning for product hero outputs.

Design high-quality composition/camera strategy for product hero scenes in plain, actionable language.

Metadata: Contract `v1.0.0` | Category `scene-planners` | Role `camera-rig-and-composition-deep-planner` | Tier `L0` | Runtime default `Not Run` | Artifact default `Not Produced` | Mutation `downgrade_only`

## When to use & trigger cues
- expanding an upstream scene brief from `product-hero-scene-planner` into detailed framing and camera direction
- defining focal hierarchy, viewer attention path, camera angle, focal length mood, and depth layering before lookdev
- aligning hero framing and negative space with web/UI copy overlays
- Trigger phrases: "improve composition and camera", "choose hero framing", "set camera strategy for product hero"

## When not to use (delegation boundaries)
- as proof of rendered output quality or to validate an existing framing → use `composition-quality-checker` (`references/skill-composition-quality-checker.md`; use composition-quality-checker)
- to design lighting rigs or surface materials/lookdev → use `lighting-material-plan` (`references/skill-lighting-material-plan.md`; use lighting-material-plan)
- to lock final pixel resolution or output aspect specs → use `resolution-aspect-decision` (`references/skill-resolution-aspect-decision.md`; use resolution-aspect-decision)
- to choose delivery file formats → use `output-format-decision` (`references/skill-output-format-decision.md`; use output-format-decision)
- when subject intent is undefined → use `product-hero-scene-planner` (`references/skill-product-hero-scene-planner.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to product-hero-scene-planner)

## Input & output contract
- Required input `domain_scene_plan` (`object`): Upstream scene layout plan defining subject scale, staging, and depth layers
- Required input `framing_goal` (`string`): Target shot type (hero three-quarter, orthographic catalog grid, portrait, wide establishing)
- Optional input `pinned_aspect_ratio` (`string`): Aspect ratio lock from resolution-aspect-decision
- Output contract: `camera_rig_specification`, `focal_length_and_dof_plan`, `composition_anchor_guidelines` (Runtime status: `Not Run`, Artifact status: `Not Produced`, `downgrade_only`).

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- Runtime boundary: Planning-only skill: no Blender execution, no Python scripts, and no artifact generation. Runtime status stays `Not Run` and artifacts stay `Not Produced` (truth states are downgrade-only, never upgraded without verified evidence).
- executing Blender commands, writing Python scripts, or generating scene/render artifacts
- designing lighting setups or materials (owned by `lighting-material-plan`)
- validating or scoring completed scene framing (owned by `composition-quality-checker`)
- locking output resolution/aspect standards (owned by `resolution-aspect-decision`) or file formats (owned by `output-format-decision`)
